facts.text: Snow left Blue Mountain Spring (5,880 ft) 37 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Blue Mountain Spring
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 16 (2023), May 10 (2024), May 7 (2025)

facts.text: At Blue Mountain Spring (5,880 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 0.5 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Blue Mountain Spring
evidence.detail: 0.5 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 21.2 in (2023), 15.4 in (2024), 21.0 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between February 10 and April 12, carried from the melt-out date at Blue Mountain Spring (5,880 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Blue Mountain Spring
evidence.detail: melted out April 3, 1,238 ft above the pass; points to February 10 to April 12
